incidents.name: LeverageSIR
incidents.notes: SIR vault stores the expected callback caller in transient storage; attacker CREATE2-deploys a contract at that exact address to pass the check and call uniswapV3SwapCallback to drain the vault.

sources.ref: Onchain review: SIR Vault 0xb91ae2c8365fd45030aba84a4666c4db074e53e7 created 2025-02-20T15:32:59Z (block 21888482) by 0x5000ff6cc1864690d947b864b9fb0d603e8d1f1a, not the attack-tx sender 0x27defcfa6498f957918f407ed8a58eba2884768c. keccak(eth_getCode) is identical at the creation and incident blocks, no EIP-1967 or beacon slot is set, and both DELEGATECALLs taken in the exploit go to 0x80f18b12a6dbd515c5ad01a2006abf30c5972158, a PUSH20 link-time constant in the vault's runtime that cannot be repointed. Deployment basis is exact.
